content:
danielle: Noticing a regression after quant test v2026-04 on promptset-multilang: BLEU down ~8% on translation-like tasks. Probable cause: subword tokenization differences for cjk scripts when using int4 kernels.
thomas: On my local int4 runs I saw token boundary shifts and different token IDs for same unicode sequences. Could be our new BPE merge table reordering under quant. I can run a token parity job.
sara: Label ops capacity is fine. We can run a bilingual microgolden focusing on Chinese/Japanese/Korean edgecases. 800 samples doable in 5 days.
maria: Proposed steps:
  - run tokenizer parity (v2 vs v3) over promptset-multilang
  - generate dedupe manifest, sample 2k edgecases biased to CJK + long strings + emoji
  - label microgolden of 800 for high-leak anchors and translation pairs
  - add 100 CJK anchors to golden and mark as critical
  - run canary with fallback to prior int8 build if quality regresses
thomas: I'll output CSV with columns: sample_id, tok_v2, tok_v3, toklen_diff, collision_flag, risk_level
labeling-bot: scheduled microgolden job mg-179555 for 800 samples, start_ts=1795560000
maria: Rollback criteria: microgolden BLEU drop >5 absolute OR anchor embed-recall drop >6%.
sara: I'll prioritize by (collision_flag=true, toklen_diff>3, high perplexity). Putting manifests in drive/curation/multilang/179555.
danielle: Also capture minimal repro set (<=30) with exact token ids + sequence text for quant-smoke.
labeling-bot: microgolden queued, waiting for manifest.
maria: OK team, let's sync tomorrow EOD and decide canary timing. Keep updates here.
labeling-bot: microgolden job update: queued (waiting manifest).
